Local syntax modification: replace two default parameters, object spread, three template strings and one block-scoped constant with ES5 equivalents.
Optional algorithm modification (2026 Ambi4Tizen contributors, Apache-2.0): dcPreview=true reconstructs a 1/8-size block-average preview from dequantized DC coefficients, retaining full entropy/progressive parsing and limits. Small/CMYK images use the complete decoder. Default decoding remains unchanged. This preview drops AC detail and is intended only for coarse LED color sampling, not image export.
Whitespace normalization: trailing spaces and final blank lines removed from decoder and package license; license wording unchanged.
